additionalDocuments.label: SAMANA Barari Lagoons · original official brochure and home drawings

review.imagery: Twenty-one own-project renders cover the tower, entrance podium, balcony/roof, leisure facilities, lobby and home interiors. All 87 extracted brochure resources and six primary gallery images were visually reviewed across five native contact panels. Generic people/foliage/health images, unpainted repeats and a hidden plan layer are excluded. The current complete-tower view supplies the card and hero. The spa image is a treatment room. No exact-unit view or completed photography is asserted.
review.floorPlans: Five complete official home sheets show a studio, 1 BR, 2 BR, 2 BR duplex and 3 BR, all labeled with a pool. The duplex sheet retains both levels, the open-to-below void, elevation and both key plans. A branded broker-hosted PDF supplies every residential floorplate from floor 1 to floor 31 as separate complete sheets. Unit numbers and source legends remain intact. Numerical unit areas and approved contractual unit matching are not printed on these sheets. Confirm the applicable unit, release and pool provision with SAMANA. All five official home sheets 39–43 and all thirty-one mirror physical pages 2–32 were visually reviewed. Floor 31 shows only 1 BR/2 BR in its legend. Intermediate duplex positions, lower-floor 3 BR variants, all unit labels and plan legends remain unedited. No area is inferred from geometry, portal minima or a similarly shaped unit.
review.location: Complete official connectivity pages 9–10 were visually reviewed. Fourteen current-primary ranges are recorded, and the brochure’s ten overlapping ranges agree. The published coordinate 25.09294985552397, 55.32096836834195 is stored with HTML hash and six-place rounding. The pin remains project vicinity. The source-era schematic does not become an operating-metro or visitor-entrance claim.
review.provenance: Primary HTML, original official brochure, native image origins and Mitchell’s complete branded floorplate PDF retain source receipts and hashes. The floorplate source remains labeled as a broker mirror. All physical source pages, original bytes and source branding remain available. Protected identity and completed text research remain intact.

unavailable: Numerical drawing-specific home areas, approved contractual unit matching, exact visitor entrance, confirmed transport services at the plot, final unit fitout/views, dated construction photographs and live journey times were not established.
